policy: Coordinates are one-based inclusive. A window is eligible only when every residue has an actual returned provider score. Do not interpolate,zero-fill or shorten unsupported windows. Among eligible windows minimize the arithmetic mean score,retaining ties within1e-10.
scope: The provider does not disclose its score scale/model. This is support-aware aggregation of that profile,not a calibrated hydrophobicity,solubility or functional prediction.
